sections.name: Team grid
sections.description: Centered company intro over a four-across people grid: initial avatars, name, role kicker and a one-line bio each, with a quiet careers CTA underneath. Use it on the about or company page once the team is worth naming; ships with placeholder people to swap at publish.

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: Short kicker above the headline; the badge renders it uppercase

props.name: members
props.doc: People to render; avatars are generated from initials, never photos or logos

props.name: showBios
props.doc: Hide the one-line bios for a tighter, names-only grid

props.name: ctaLabel
props.doc: Careers CTA under the grid; empty string hides it

props.name: footnote
props.doc: Muted placeholder disclaimer; empty string hides it

sections.name: Careers band
sections.description: Split hiring band: mission headline and three working values on one side, an open-roles card with location and type per role on the other, plus a built-in empty state for between hiring rounds. A momentum signal; place it once, mid growth-story, not as a default block.

sections.name: 404 section
sections.description: Full-page not-found state in Alfred's voice: gradient display numeral, 'this page isn't in my memory' framing, a primary route home, and a quick-links row to the pages people were probably after. Use it as the body of every unmatched route, under the site nav.

props.doc: Ghost CTA beside the primary; empty string hides it

props.doc: Kicker over the quick-links row

props.name: links
props.doc: Quick links to likely destinations; an empty array hides the row

sections.name: Cookie consent
sections.description: Consent banner as a floating card: plain-language cookie copy, an accept-all / essentials-only split, and an expandable preferences panel with per-category toggles, a locked essential row, and a saved confirmation. Pin it above the footer; the copy promises no ad trackers, so keep that true.

props.doc: Text button that expands the preferences panel

props.name: saveLabel
props.doc: Save button inside the expanded panel

props.name: preferences
props.doc: Cookie categories; a locked row renders an 'Always on' badge instead of a toggle

props.doc: Render with the preferences panel already open

props.name: savedText
props.doc: Status line after any choice is saved

sections.name: Ask AI about us
sections.description: Pre-footer GEO block: three prefilled questions about Alfred and one-click handoffs that open the selected prompt in an external assistant, plus a copy-the-prompt fallback. Confidence play for AI-referred sceptics; place it once per site, pre-footer, and keep the prompts honest.
